Overfitting checks

Quick checks of the trade list

Quick checks

From the trade list, no rerun: 200 runs each, seed 0

0 passed, 0 failed, 3 not judged, 1 informational.

Passing a check proves nothing on its own. These checks read the run's own trades: a failure says the edge is fragile or small next to the noise of those trades, and none of them can see a strategy picked as the best of many tried. A check with too little to judge says not judged and why, and never passes.

1,809 closed trades; the checks need 30 to judge

#CheckQuestionFigureRuleVerdict
2Random out of sampleWas the out-of-sample period just lucky?n/aat least 80% of assignments keep 50% of the in-sample sharpe out of sample (30% of the sessions out of sample)not judged
10Trade reshuffleHow deep can the drawdown get in another order?95% of orders stay within -50.0% (the run's order -48.5%)informational: give reshuffle={'max_drawdown': 0.25} to judgeinformational
11Trade resampleHow wide is the range of outcomes?n/aat least 95% of paths profitable and at most 5% of paths falling 50% from a peaknot judged
13VarianceDoes it survive a worse win rate?n/aat least 80% of paths profitable with the win rate 5 points lowernot judged

result.robustness() runs the full set of checks, with charts.

09

Notes

Method, assumptions & warnings

How the figures were computed

Returns are time weighted: cash flows move the equity but are not returns. Each IST session date contributes one return, from the last equity point of the date.

Volatility, Sharpe, Sortino and alpha are annualised with 247.83 sessions a year: the NSE calendar in 2022 to 2026, holiday data sourced. CAGR uses elapsed calendar time.

Risk-free rate 0.00% a year, compounded down to 0.0000% a session.

Every drawdown figure is a fall, so it is zero or negative. The benchmark's figures are measured as the strategy's are, on its known session returns. Each metric's definition shows on its label; every definition cites its source in the documentation of openalgo.backtest.metrics.

instrumentsSBIN: generic cash-equity instrument assumed (lot 1, tick 0.05, no freeze quantity, NSE equity costs); pass instrument= for its own terms; RELIANCE: generic cash-equity instrument assumed (lot 1, tick 0.05, no freeze quantity, NSE equity costs); pass instrument= for its own terms; MAXHEALTH: generic cash-equity instrument assumed (lot 1, tick 0.05, no freeze quantity, NSE equity costs); pass instrument= for its own terms; CIPLA: generic cash-equity instrument assumed (lot 1, tick 0.05, no freeze quantity, NSE equity costs); pass instrument= for its own terms
benchmarkNIFTY on NSE_INDEX: 1152 daily closes from Historify (source='db'), 2022-03-31 to 2026-11-20
indicator_checkswindow tolerance 1e-06 (relative); atr(SBIN.high, SBIN.low, SBIN.close, 10): truncation passed at 4 cuts, warm-up 256 bars; atr(RELIANCE.high, RELIANCE.low, RELIANCE.close, 10): truncation passed at 4 cuts, warm-up 256 bars; atr(MAXHEALTH.high, MAXHEALTH.low, MAXHEALTH.close, 10): truncation passed at 4 cuts, warm-up 256 bars; atr(CIPLA.high, CIPLA.low, CIPLA.close, 10): truncation passed at 4 cuts, warm-up 256 bars
warm_upautomatic: no decision before start, nor for a symbol before every self.I indicator of it has closed its warm-up of bars (its window-stability length on the engine's reference bars, the same for any data and in live trading; bars before start count); atr(SBIN.high, SBIN.low, SBIN.close, 10) needs 256 1h bars of SBIN; atr(RELIANCE.high, RELIANCE.low, RELIANCE.close, 10) needs 256 1h bars of RELIANCE; atr(MAXHEALTH.high, MAXHEALTH.low, MAXHEALTH.close, 10) needs 256 1h bars of MAXHEALTH; atr(CIPLA.high, CIPLA.low, CIPLA.close, 10) needs 256 1h bars of CIPLA; history before start: SBIN 259 strategy bars from 2022-02-07 to 2022-03-31 (asked from 2022-01-12), RELIANCE 259 strategy bars from 2022-02-07 to 2022-03-31 (asked from 2022-01-12), MAXHEALTH 259 strategy bars from 2022-02-07 to 2022-03-31 (asked from 2022-01-12), CIPLA 259 strategy bars from 2022-02-07 to 2022-03-31 (asked from 2022-01-12); ready at start

Verified on 2026-11-12; later trade dates are charged at these rates and flagged unverified. The start date is the day the Finance Act 2026 F&O STT rates took effect; no other change between that day and the snapshot is known. NSE rows keep the calculator's split between transaction charge and IPFT (NSE circular NSE/FA/73061 moved all but Rs 0.01 per crore of IPFT into the transaction charge in March 2026); the sum is what is charged. Unverified rows say why in their own notes: BSE groups X and SS, BSE options other than Sensex and Bankex. MCX CASTORSEED, RBDPMOLEIN, PEPPER and KAPAS pay the uniform Rs 2.10 per lakh of MCX/F&A/631/2024, not the contract-specific rates of the snapshot, which predate 2024-10-01.
